# Bundle: cluster-manager

A cluster manager's knowledge instance - documentation, tickets, operational memory and, optionally, ServiceNow, Slurm, HTCondor, node health and code.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Version | `0.1.0` |
| Extends | nothing |
| Okg versions it supports | `>=0.2.0,<0.3` |

## Packs

- Default: [`docsite`](../packs/docsite.md), [`tickets`](../packs/tickets.md), [`ops-record`](../packs/ops-record.md)
- Optional: [`servicenow`](../packs/servicenow.md), [`slurm`](../packs/slurm.md), [`htcondor`](../packs/htcondor.md), [`git-code`](../packs/git-code.md), [`node-health`](../packs/node-health.md), [`ticket-triage`](../packs/ticket-triage.md)

Default packs install with the bundle. Add an optional pack with `--with <pack>` at init, or `archi add <pack>` later.

```bash
archi init myteam --bundle cluster-manager
```

Suggested questions:

- How do I drain a node in Slurm, and what does the documentation say about it?

## Automation level bounds

The bundle sets no bound. Each automation pack's own limit applies.
